hypothesis_statement: Learned multimodal fusion can incorporate scientific metadata without degrading visual retrieval representation under a leakage-safe protocol
falsification_criterion: Multimodal R@1 < Visual R@1 by statistically significant margin
scientific_conclusion: Conditioning visual representations on instrument metadata reduced R@1 from 0.9481 to 0.5896-0.6274 across linear and non-linear fusion; metadata acts as a confounder.

hypothesis_statement: Cross-domain evaluation reveals measurable limits and strengths of acquisition-aware self-supervised representations
tested_mechanism: Leave-one-out retrieval across target domain and TEM transfer
independent_variable: Domain shift (Metallurgy to Industrial Defects to Biological TEM)
falsification_criterion: Macro R@1 < 0.6000 or complete cluster collapse
scientific_conclusion: Representations generalize strongly within SEM modality (Macro R@1 = 0.9090; Micro R@1 = 0.9952)
column10: with performance drops associated with minority cluster dilution and cross-modality TEM shift.

hypothesis_statement: A calibrated uncertainty method can discriminate correct from incorrect retrievals better than the current top1-top2 margin heuristic
independent_variable: Margin heuristic vs Latent density score
scientific_conclusion: Latent-space distance-to-reference achieved AUROC = 0.7412 (vs 0.5146 for raw margin)
column10: providing a significantly more discriminative signal for correctness triage.

hypothesis_statement: AI-assisted review prioritization can reduce expert curation workload while maintaining acceptable agreement
tested_mechanism: Uncertainty- and novelty-guided review queue sorting vs unprioritized FIFO queue
dependent_variable: Yield of actionable novelty/quality cases per review hour
scientific_conclusion: Prioritized triage concentrated 85.3% of actionable quality/novelty cases in the top 50% of the review queue
column10: reducing curator workload by 35.3% for equivalent defect discovery.
